title: Selecting DOM Elements
ques: Compare legacy selector methods (`getElementById`, `getElementsByClassName`) with modern query selectors (`querySelector`, `querySelectorAll`). Write examples selecting single and multiple elements.
explanation: `querySelector` returns the first element matching any CSS selector query, while `querySelectorAll` returns all matching elements as a NodeList.

title: Handling User Events in the DOM
ques: Explain how to attach event listeners using **`addEventListener`**. Write a code snippet listening to button click and form input change events.
explanation: `addEventListener` binds event handlers to DOM nodes. The `event` parameter provides rich context such as target element, mouse coordinates, and key presses.

title: Modifying HTML Content and CSS Styles
ques: Demonstrate how to update element text with `textContent`, modify HTML with `innerHTML`, toggle CSS classes with `classList`, and update inline CSS styles.
explanation: `textContent` is safe against XSS attacks. `classList` provides clean methods (`add`, `remove`, `toggle`) to manage CSS styling without clobbering existing classes.
